text.content:
Where you live when you've made it.

Region: Night City, north-east
Controlled by: Money; the Tyger Claws in Japantown
Feel: Estates, entertainment and very good security
Notable locations: Charter Hill: Dynalar Complex, Kiroshi Campus, Red Queen's Race. Japantown: Cherry Blossom, Clouds (atop Megabuilding H8), Dark Matter, Fourth Wall Studios, Jig-Jig Street. North Oak: Arasaka Estate, Chram Denya Jinja, Columbarium, North Oak Casino and Country Club, Villa Eurodyne

The rich keep their estates in Westbrook. It grew out of the walled Executive Zone after the 4th Corporate War, when the powerful paid to expand it and hired mercenaries to clear out the poor around it.

Charter Hill is for those still climbing. Japantown is the city's entertainment center, with the Tyger Claws taking a cut of every eddie. North Oak has the most wealth and fewest people in the city, and its guards shoot first.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.22
